data.name: Stamina Adjuster
data.shortDescription: Allows adjustment of player stamina values.
data.description:
A simple mod that lets you tweak how stamina works in Sons of the Forest.

You can adjust things like:

- How fast stamina regenerates

- How much stamina you have overall

- How much stamina running and jumping uses

- How much stamina you need before you can start running

- Stamina penalties from cold weather

- Stat-based stamina regen effects

- Separate settings for Normal and Hard difficulty where it makes sense

- Changes apply instantly, so you can fine-tune values without restarting.

Multiplayer note:
For stability and fairness, stamina changes are server-side only. The mod is disabled for clients in multiplayer games.

Once I figure out multiplayer syncing I will allow the host to determine if they want clients to be able to adjust it.
